name: documentpro
label: DocumentPro
description: DocumentPro is an AI-powered document processing platform that automates data extraction from various document types using advanced machine learning algorithms.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To get your DocumentPro API Key:

1. **Login** to your DocumentPro account
2. **Go to** https://app.documentpro.ai/workflows
3. **Select** a workflow
4. **Change tab** to "Workflow" from the top bar
5. **Find** the "Upload" tab
6. **Click** "Upload via API"
7. **Click** the "Generate API Key" button
8. **Copy** your API key and paste it here

runExtract.label: Run Extract
runExtract.description: Run an extract/workflow on an uploaded document

document_id.label: Document ID
document_id.description: The unique identifier of the document to parse

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: The unique identifier of the Workflow/template to use

use_ocr.label: Use OCR
use_ocr.description: Enable OCR processing (required for gpt-3.5-turbo or OCR-related parameters)

query_model.label: Query Model
query_model.description: The AI model to use for parsing

detect_tables.label: Detect Tables
detect_tables.description: Detect tables in the document (requires use_ocr=true)

chunk_by_pages.label: Chunk by Pages
chunk_by_pages.description: Number of pages per segment for method 1 segmentation

start_regex.label: Start Regex
start_regex.description: Regex pattern for where parsing should begin (requires use_ocr=true)

end_regex.label: End Regex
end_regex.description: Regex pattern for where parsing should end (requires use_ocr=true)

split_regex.label: Split Regex
split_regex.description: Regex pattern to split the document into sections (requires use_ocr=true)

use_all_matches.label: Use All Matches
use_all_matches.description: Use all regex matches instead of just the first (requires use_ocr=true)
